blockers.wanted: a busyness knob on cloth.motion with claim density that verify accepts
blockers.workaround: left the macro unclaimed; density read 213/82/188/198/206 per s across 0..1 and differed per seed

blockers.where: macro claim attack for burst softness
blockers.wanted: claim that tracks how soft the individual burst onsets are
blockers.tried: transient attack_db macro with claim attack; the attack measure is whole-sound time to the loudest peak, so it jumps between bursts (56 -> 617 ms) and fails on another seed

blockers.wanted: one number for the softest/hardest onset attack across bursts
blockers.tried: onset table attack_ms column (2.75 to 25 ms per burst before softening)
blockers.workaround: transient attack_db -12 after cloth; did not re-read the table after the change, so softness of the final onsets is not confirmed

blockers.wanted: a way to get 2-4 smooth swells from cloth alone
blockers.tried: cloth motion fed from a wander/lfo
blockers.workaround: multiplied cloth by an expr envelope (raised cosine at 3.75 Hz with a 0.15 floor); cloth is sparse bursts so the swells are only partly filled (one swell near 0.45 s is weak)

wishlist: cloth `smooth`/`grain` field that rounds burst onsets and fills swells
a per-burst median attack claim for macros
density claim stable for sparse power-law burst nodes
what_worked: cloth gave the right broadband noise, centroid 5.1-6.1 kHz, no pitch (voiced 0%) in one node
expr as a swell envelope gave 3 swells in one call
brightness macro on cloth.weight passed the centroid claim on 4 seeds
